Original Orrery skeletal-animation fixture: CC0-1.0

The asymmetric strip geometry, four-color texture, two-joint hierarchy,
inverse-bind matrices, animation clips, and authoring script were created
specifically for Orrery's skeletal-animation tests in October 2026 by the
OpenAI coding assistant under the repository user's task authorization.
They were not downloaded, copied from Khronos samples, or generated from
third-party assets. No external image generator was used.

To the extent copyright applies, these original fixture files and script
are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Files: animated_strip.gltf, animated_strip.glb, animated_strip_generate.py.
The glTF/GLB schema follows the Khronos glTF 2.0 specification; the geometry
and animation content are original, not a Khronos sample asset.

Reproduce with Python 3 (standard library only):
  python3 animated_strip_generate.py

Both formats embed the same mesh, PNG, rig and two named clips (bend/pulse).
Node 0 is a translated non-joint ancestor; node 1 is the lower joint;
node 2 is the upper joint at y=1.5; node 3 is the skinned mesh translated
by x=7. Per glTF the skinned mesh-node transform is ignored. Both inverse
bind matrices are nonidentity, cancelling the joint bind-world transforms.
The eight asymmetric mesh-local vertices span y=0..3 and use mixed joint
weights on the middle two rows. bend uses LINEAR quaternion rotation;
pulse combines STEP translation of the non-joint ancestor with LINEAR
scale of the lower joint. The 4x4 RGBA checker texture is asymmetric too.
